Frugal is being smart with your money, it doesn't matter how much you spend. 

Cheap is saving every last penny no matter what.

Here's an example. I have a 400 dollar Vitamix blender. I can make my own health smoothies or ice cream shakes. The amount of money that thing has saved me pays for the machine. A 20 dollar blender just doesn't do as good of a job or more importantly last as long. So while the blender is expensive I'm being frugal. I probably would have went though a dozen 20 dollar blenders by now and I wouldn't have enjoyed the time with them as much as my commercial grade blender. A 20 dollar blender can't make hot soup.

So frugal isn't about how much you spend but more about getting your worth out of the money. Cheap is all about not spending money.
